criterion: 借用、轉移、共享、取消與非同步逾時案例符合生命週期；不將 shared lifetime 當作寫入權限。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Cancellation stops new work but keeps the shared block until the last reader releases it. Required finding for the counterexample: Timeout frees a still-borrowed block: MEM-LIFE-001 failure.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
